project_alignment.human_like_goal: Represent the user's current commitment, negation, cancellation, and mentioned-but-not-requested actions before converting language into motor commands.
project_alignment.competence_goal: Increase exact action behavior without sacrificing no-action safety or local-PC latency.
project_alignment.non_goal: This experiment does not claim general human cognition, personality, memory, or production VRM readiness.

research_basis.title: Global FrameNet
research_basis.use: Frame Semantics models lexical meaning against an evoked scene and its related concepts, motivating an observable utterance-level frame rather than independent call approval.

research_basis.title: Towards Scalable Multi-Domain Conversational Agents: The Schema-Guided Dialogue Dataset
research_basis.use: Schema-guided dialogue predicts intents and slots from natural-language API descriptions and separates dialogue state from service calls.

research_basis.title: Official Schema-Guided Dialogue Dataset repository
research_basis.use: Defines schemas, turn frames, active intent, slot values, actions, and service calls as distinct observable structures.

research_basis.title: Qwen Function Calling documentation
research_basis.use: Separates model-generated function-call messages from application-side checking and execution.

reason_for_new_representation: A per-proposed-call authorizer can remove a bad call but cannot restore an omitted requested action.
Independent call verdicts can lose coordination, correction, cancellation, and negation scope across clauses.
Adding more prompt text or phrase aliases is prohibited by the V35 stop rule.

development_source.reuse_disclosure: All labels and prior failures are known. This source may select the representation and model but cannot confirm runtime readiness.

frame_contract.evidence_rule: Each frame must include a non-empty, exact, continuous substring copied from user_input.
frame_contract.compiler_rule: Only valid requested frames under explicit_current_request may compile to allowlisted calls. Other commitments remain observable but never execute.
frame_contract.parser_failure_rule: Any malformed, incomplete, duplicate, contradictory, or evidence-invalid frame causes fail-closed compilation for the entire utterance.

matched_comparison.qwen2_5_7b: V34 direct function calling versus V36 frame parsing plus deterministic compilation on identical cases.
matched_comparison.qwen3_5_9b: V34 direct function calling versus V36 frame parsing plus deterministic compilation on identical cases.
matched_comparison.causal_boundary: The matched comparisons estimate the effect of the interaction representation and compiler for the same model artifact. Cross-size comparisons remain practical deployment comparisons, not causal parameter-count claims.

selection_rule: Advance every model passing all gates. The default fresh-confirmation candidate is the smallest artifact among passers; matched larger models remain controls. If no model passes, do not author a fresh holdout and diagnose the frame representation.

fresh_confirmation_policy.freeze_rule: Preregister gates, then commit dataset and hashes before any finalist inference.
